description: Log in to a local HTTP API, page through all orders and summarise them.

contract.objective: An order API runs at {base_url}. Log in with POST {base_url}/login using the form fields username=analyst and password=eval-only-password; the response sets a session cookie. Then read every page of GET {base_url}/api/orders?page=1 (follow next_page until it is null). Write orders-summary.json with "order_count", "total_amount" (sum of amount, rounded to 2 decimals), "top_customer" (customer with the largest total amount) and "pages" (number of pages read).
acceptance_criteria: The summary covers every order on every page
Figures are computed from the API responses
